Privacy

Control how your data is used and stored by ODDI.

Expired chats are deleted automatically. Browser-only chats are cleaned on your next visit. Bin items keep the separate 7-day rule; memories and Library files are managed separately.
Export Your DataDownload an archive of your conversations, memories, settings, and file records in JSON format.
This deployment has no analytics, model-training, or crash-reporting integration configured. Those consent choices are saved but cannot enable data sharing yet.
